label: request
author: LLJones29
body:
You can [request](https://bluemaxima.org/flashpoint/datahub/Request_Form) at Flashpoint.  I figure if it's popular it may have already been requested though (haven't checked) in which case could mean it's unrecoverable since it doesn't seem to be available on there.  I don't understand flash at all.  Seems like it's simple but I guess it isn't.  It's something I've wanted to look into more but never get around to.

[first archive domain.](https://web.archive.org/web/*/http://theroomz.freehost.pl/*)

[second archive domain.](https://web.archive.org/web/*/http://theroomz.yoyo.pl/*)

[third archive domain.](https://web.archive.org/web/*/http://dreamwardgames.com/theroomz/*)

[review / walkthrough.](https://jayisgames.com/review/the-roomz.php)

[original flashkit board topic.](https://board.flashkit.com/board/showthread.php?708493-game-The-Roomz)

Hopefully I've given you enough there to work with.
